name: Thorvaldsson
saga: Four point nine four minutes each way at arrival, so a question and its answer is under ten. The Thorvaldssons hold the masts and are the reason a core of nine can carry its own signaller rather than borrow one — a borrowed signaller is a choke point inside the core before it leaves the ground.

tiers.note: One mast. Everything routes through it, which is the problem.
Two masts, and now nothing routes through either one alone.
Three. The graph stops having a cut vertex in it.
Four, and a mast can be down without anybody noticing in time to worry.
Redundancy is not a spare. It is the absence of a single answer to who carries the message.
